subject: MAP Draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - Aurelia Tech
messages:
From: Marcello Ruiz <m.ruiz@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Intro + next steps (Redwood / Aurelia)

Hey Marissa — thanks for the intro call today. Helpful to hear how Redwood handles routing and fallback models. Two asks from our side as we align internally: 

1) Can you send over a MAP (mutual action plan) draft we can share with procurement + security? I'd like milestone-level items (security review, SOC 2 package, PO/contract, pilot start).
2) Our security team will need the SOC2 questionnaire and an evidence list so they can start a gap analysis.

Proposed internal timeline: security review week of Mar 1, procurement/term review the week after. Is that feasible?

Also looping in security@aurelia-tech.com for any immediate questions.

Thanks,
Marcello
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Aurelia Tech

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Marcello Ruiz <m.ruiz@aurelia-tech.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 10:01:00 -0800
Subject: MAP Draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - Aurelia Tech

Marcello — great to meet you yesterday. Thanks for the clear asks. Attached is a MAP draft and our SOC 2 one-pager to get started. High level MAP milestones (draft):

- M1: Security intake & questionnaire sent (owner: Aurelia) — target: 2026-02-26 (status: awaiting completed questionnaire)
- M2: Redwood provides SOC 2 package (report summary, control matrix, evidence list) (owner: Redwood) — target: 2026-03-03 (dependency: signed NDA/attachments below)
- M3: Security review call (Redwood + Aurelia security) — target: 2026-03-05 (owner: both)
- M4: Procurement & terms review (Redwood legal + Aurelia procurement) — target: 2026-03-12 (owner: Aurelia/Redwood)
- M5: Pilot kickoff (limited production traffic) — target: 2026-03-22 (owner: Aurelia product)

Responsibilities / dependencies:
- Aurelia: complete SOC2 questionnaire (attached) and provide any additional control artifacts they need to validate controls.
- Redwood: deliver SOC2 summary, control mappings, and a zipped evidence manifest with named artifacts or stubs by Mar 3. We'll also provide a short walkthrough deck.
- Both: schedule security review meeting for the week of Mar 1–7 — propose Thu Mar 5 10:00 PT.

Attachments: redwood-map-draft-aurelia-20260226.pdf (MAP draft), redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC2 summary). I also attached the SOC2 questionnaire template for Aurelia to fill (SOC2-questionnaire-aurelia-tech.xlsx) — feel free to add notes inline.

Next steps: 
- Marcello: confirm the questionnaire owner and whether Thu 3/5 10:00 PT works.
- Rishi: once Marcello confirms, can you prepare the evidence manifest and propose the 60–90 minute security walkthrough agenda?

Thanks — looping in Rishi and Laura as our security/CS leads.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marcello Ruiz <m.ruiz@aurelia-tech.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 08:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - Aurelia Tech

Marcello — thanks, I can own the evidence manifest and the walkthrough. Drafted a short list of typical artifacts we'll provide as stubs (if we can't share full binaries) and the proposed agenda: 

Typical evidence list (examples):
- SOC2 report summary (redwood-soc2-summary.pdf)
- Control mapping spreadsheet (controls-mapping.csv) 
- Access control screenshots (IAM roles, RBAC) — names and timestamps redacted
- Change management policy (policy-cm-v2.pdf)
- Incident response runbook (ir-runbook.pdf)
- Encryption key management description (KMS-ops.txt)

Proposed security walkthrough agenda (60–75 mins):
- 0–10m intros & scope
- 10–30m architecture & data flow (Redwood infra, model hosting options, VPC/private deployment)
- 30–50m control mappings & evidence review (control by control)
- 50–65m Q&A & next steps (open items + evidence delivery plan)

I'll prepare a ZIP with named stubs and a short README explaining what we can share vs. what requires an NDA or redaction. Marissa — I'll target delivering that ZIP by Mar 3 (to meet the MAP M2 target).

If Aurelia security can confirm preferred meeting time, I'll book a calendly placeholder.

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marcello Ruiz <m.ruiz@aurelia-tech.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Aurelia Tech Security <security@aurelia-tech.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Mar 2026 09:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: MAP Draft: SOC 2 package delivery & security review - Aurelia Tech

Thanks for the fast turn. Confirming: 
- Questionnaire owner: myself (I'll coordinate with our infosec analyst, Priya). We'll aim to return the completed questionnaire by EOD Mon Mar 2.
- Security walkthrough: Thu Mar 5 10:00 PT works for our team. Please send a calendar invite and the README you mentioned.
- Evidence needs: our security team will initially review the summary and control mappings; if anything is missing we'll flag it in the walkthrough and via a follow-up thread.

Marcello Ruiz
Director, IT Risk & Compliance
Aurelia Tech
